headline: No defect found in the delivered bookkeeping. All nine independent adversarial controls pass. Findings concern what the bound omits and a separation that holds by dimension rather than by design.

call_format_inventory.input: state(32) || len(label) u64le(8) || label || len(data) u64le(8) || data

call_format_inventory.length_bytes: 22+len(domain); 63 for PROFILE, 50 for the seam DOMAIN

overlaps.8_equals_9: identical untagged 64-byte domain; a statement about input sets, not a collision claim
overlaps.2_vs_8_9: a 64-byte absorb needs len(label)+len(data)==16; its bytes 32..40 are a small LE length while a node's are digest head, so about 2^-64, a bound not an impossibility
overlaps.3: uniquely separated; 47 is below the absorb floor and not a multiple of 8
overlaps.5: genuinely separate; keyed blake3 is a different function family

fa8_dispositions.H4_four_uses_disjoint: FALSE as stated. The cited prefixes occur only in the three initialisation calls (rows 1,4,5); absorb, squeeze_bytes, refill, hash_column, salt_leaf and hash_pair carry none. Rows 8 and 9 share a domain outright.
fa8_dispositions.H3_keyed_XOF: refined, not broken. The key derivation is keyed (row 5); the refill that produces the stream is UNKEYED blake3 over key||counter (row 6), so RNG queries live in the same unkeyed table at length 40. A reduction may not treat the RNG as an independent oracle.

bookkeeping_audit.fresh_query_programming: correct; program_fresh refuses an answered point (:34-:36) and fixes output width (:37-:38)
bookkeeping_audit.one_shared_table: correct; nodes, inner column hashes and salted leaves share RandomOracle.table
bookkeeping_audit.prepared_leaf_reuse: correct; fresh handles per owner (:72), tree built before any column is seen (:72-:77)
bookkeeping_audit.duplicate_indices: correct; identical column, salt and path returned (:92-:97)
bookkeeping_audit.conflicting_duplicates: correct; refuses (:93-:95) and burns the owner
bookkeeping_audit.prequeries: correct; a pre-answered salted-leaf point forces a refusal
bookkeeping_audit.owner_consumption: correct; spent set before validation, burn on failure (:80-:82)
bookkeeping_audit.abort_visibility: correct and observable; distinct refusal messages

bound_gaps.stated_bound: q / 2^256 for one programmed salted leaf, given the inner digest is fixed before the fresh salt
missing: union over the 512 programmed leaves per proof (256 per endpoint x 2)
union over the 1792 unopened leaves per endpoint, which in the real world are images of salt_leaf(hash_column(col),salt) and in the simulation are free handles explained by nothing
the distinguisher's own verification queries, which enter the same table (13 entries per forged opening)
preparation history: points answered before SimPrepare can already block a later programming
couplings to committed polynomials, sumcheck distributions, CFS rounds, pads and encoded columns

reduction_bias_floor.per_draw_bias: 2^-64 (documented at rng.rs:73 and transcript.rs:96; exact figure derived in FA8 section D.4, not re-derived here)
reduction_bias_floor.note: before A, H, W, M and every challenge are counted; this term exceeds q/2^256 by tens of orders of magnitude for any realistic q

F10_6_index_coverage.closed_by: HighIndexPaths (2047, 2046, 1024, 1023 and a level-10 sibling tamper)
